messages:
Jordan Lee: Pushed a mock for the Batch Inputs page + Rerank preview. Wanted quick eyes on export/privacy copy and a couple accessibility points. https://staging.redwood.host/batch-inputs :wave:
Rhea Singh: Looked through it. Two quick calls: make the preview sampling explicit ("previewing 200 of 50,000") and surface an option -> 'Export metadata only' for customers who don't need raw vectors.
Tom Alvarez: From infra: we can generate two flavors of export: full (vectors + metadata) and metadata-only. Full exports will be NDJSON streamed. Need to show an estimated file size before download.
Jordan Lee: Good. UX question: label the primary export button "Download (full)" or "Download vectors"? I worry about ambiguity.
Rhea Singh: Prefer explicit: "Download: Vectors + Scores (NDJSON)" and a secondary button "Download: Metadata only (CSV)". Keep the main CTA prominent.
accessibility-bot: a11y-scan: Suggest adding descriptive text for the "preview sampling" area and ensure keyboard focus lands on the sample table when opened. Also verify table headers announce sorting state.
Tom Alvarez: Also, for NDJSON we should include a small preview on the modal with one example line so users know format. E.g. :
```
{"id":"123","text":"Reset password flow","embedding":[0.01,-0.3,...],"score":0.91}
```
Jordan Lee: Nice. I'll add that snippet and a one-liner: "NDJSON: one JSON object per line; includes raw vectors".
Rhea Singh: Accessibility nit: the heatmap cell contrast fails WCAG. We should replace the current orange on white with a darker tone, and include textual value as tooltip + visible on hover/focus.
Jordan Lee: On the sample table, we currently truncate embeddings with "[0.01, -0.32, ...]". Proposal: make the cell copy a button that toggles an expanded drawer to view full vector for selected row (only in preview, not exported inline to avoid accidental PII exposure).
Tom Alvarez: For huge batches, full vector preview could be expensive. Limit expansion to 25 rows and show a warning: "Viewing raw vectors may expose sensitive content" and require a click to confirm.
accessibility-bot: For the drawer, ensure focus management and an `aria-labelledby` header. Announce when raw vectors are displayed: "Raw vector view open for item 123".
Rhea Singh: Copy tweak for privacy: near the export buttons add a short line: "Exports may contain user content. Check data usage policy before downloading." Link to policy modal.
Jordan Lee: Also thinking about rerank behavior copy. When user toggles "Rerank by relevance", the results update but we should indicate whether rerank is local (client-side) or server-side. Suggest small badge: "server rerank" with tooltip: "Stable scores from model X at version Y".
Tom Alvarez: We'll include model version and confidence bucket in telemetry. Also add a fallback if server rerank fails: show unmodified order and a subtle inline toast: "Rerank temporarily unavailable 3: falling back to uploaded order".
Rhea Singh: UX small: move the similarity score column next to text (not at far right). Users scan left-to-right and want score next to content.
Jordan Lee: Good call. Final checklist from this thread: make sampling explicit, add NDJSON sample, two export buttons with explicit labels, size estimate, privacy copy, limit vector expansion + confirm, heatmap contrast fix, aria-live announcements for sorting/drawer, move score column. I'll open a PR with updated mock and copy.
build-bot: preview-deploy: build 2026-03-02T09:12 deployed for branch `batch-export-clarity`
Tom Alvarez: After PR, let's run a 50k synthetic test for download size estimates and a quick NVDA sweep.
Rhea Singh: I'll volunteer to proof the export modal copy and run contrast checks.
Jordan Lee: Thanks team 60 PR incoming in ~30m. Any objections?
